messages:
anya: Quick sync — planning the next pilot cohort intake. Need to lock recruitment capacity, acceptance gates, and feedback cadence by EOD Fri. Who can confirm capacity? 
devon: Eng estimate: we can support up to 12 active pilot customers concurrently without extra infra work. :thumbsup: 
maria: From research, meaningful feedback needs ~3 weeks of usage + weekly checkpoints. Recommend 2-week ramp + 3-week main window. 
sam: Support can cover 8 customers with full SLAs (1h during business hrs). >8 needs on-call rotation. 
anya: OK — so brushable numbers: 8 full-SLA, 4 light-support. Ops, is that realistic for onboarding throughput? 
ops-bot: deploy-schedule: next onboarding wave start 2024-08-19, capacity slots open: 10. See /onboard-schedule 
ops-bot: note: onboarding runbook v2 uploaded to Confluence: https://redwood.co/confluence/pilot-onboard-v2 
ops-bot reacts :white_check_mark: 
devon: Also flag: model variant A has higher token costs — we should reserve 2 slots for canary (model A) and 10 for general (model B quantized). 
maria: For feedback loops: weekly 30m checkpoints + asynchronous pulse survey (5 q's) at day 7, 21, and 35. We'll track precision/recall-like metrics and qualitative notes. 
anya: Acceptance criteria draft:
```
- Integration completed (API keys, sample app) within 5 business days
- No high-sev security blockers
- Baseline traffic >= 100 requests/day for 7 consecutive days
- Agree to feedback cadence and participate in 2 scheduled interviews
```
anya: Can each owner ack items: recruitment (anya), onboarding (devon), support (sam), research (maria)? 
devon: ack — will prepare onboarding checklist & early-rollback plan. 
sam: ack — preparing support playbook, escalation paths. 
maria: ack — will draft pulse survey + interview guide, will instrument 5 canonical prompts to monitor drift. 
anya: Next steps: I’ll publish a one-pager and a signup form. Deadline: Wed COB. Also ask sales for 6 candidates to invite -> @sales please nominate. 
sales: noted, will send list by Tue. 
anya: Great. Final: anyone think we should shorten the main window to 2 weeks? Concerned about noise but time to iterate. 
maria: keep 3 weeks — more signal. 
devon: +1 to 3 weeks for model-stability checks. 
anya: OK closing on 3 weeks. Thanks all. :rocket:
